title: Target Library Domain File
description: A curated, selectable target library for one human body site. Hierarchy: domain -> process (physiological process the user cares about) -> enzyme (the screening target). Every enzyme entry must stay traceable: EC numbers come from IUBMB enzyme nomenclature, and evidence_refs may only be filled with identifiers that were actually retrieved.

library_version.description: Semantic version of this domain file.

reviewed_on.description: Date of the last curation pass. Not a claim that the content was literature-audited.

content_status.description: curated = reviewed breadth for this site; starter = seed list, expect gaps.

keywords_zh.description: Natural-language words a user may type for this whole body site.

selection_hint_zh.description: How to help the user choose: what to ask them before picking a process.

expansion.description: How this domain file came to exist. Present on generated domains so a starter list is never mistaken for a reviewed one.

role.description: shipped_example = a reference domain that ships with the plugin to show the shape of a target and give a zero-config start; it is NOT a coverage claim. user_defined = a domain someone added for their own body site.

attention.description: How likely this taxon is to matter for function mining at this site.

keywords_zh.description: Plain user words for this process, e.g. 油脂分泌 / 出油 / 油性皮肤.

why_it_matters_zh.description: Why this process is a worthwhile screening target.

host_context_zh.description: The host-side physiology, stated as context rather than as a microbial claim.

microbe_effect_zh.description: What microbial enzymes are expected to do to that host process.

key_taxa.description: Scientific names that carry this process; each must also appear in domain.focus_taxa or be a deliberate one-off.

gene_symbols.description: Gene or locus symbols only when the symbol itself is well established; otherwise leave empty.

ec.description: Empty string when ec_confidence is none.

ec_confidence.description: full = complete EC number, family = family-level such as 3.1.1.-, none = no EC assigned to this activity.

cofactor.description: Empty string when no cofactor is required.

fold_hint.description: Structural fold or family hint for structure prediction, or empty string.

entry_point.description: Recommended workflow entry point: substrate-product reaction, EC number, or a known sequence.

dark_matter.description: True when the activity is real but has no EC number or no characterized representative enzyme.

priority.description: Screening priority for this enzyme within its process.

evidence_status.description: curated_prior = curation-level prior, not yet literature-audited. Only literature-evidence may promote it to literature_verified.

evidence_refs.description: Verified identifiers such as PMID:12345678 or DOI:10.xxxx/yyyy. Must stay empty until literature-evidence actually retrieves them.

provenance_note_zh.description: What the entry rests on, stated honestly, e.g. EC number from IUBMB nomenclature rather than a cited paper.

validation_note_zh.description: The experiment that would actually falsify the proposed microbial function.

provenance_source.description: Where the factual content of this entry came from. Required on domains generated by scripts/build_library_domain.py.
